task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale+bias over a 256x256 bf16 array, comparing a block shape misaligned to bf16's native (16,128) VMEM tile against an aligned one.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: achieved throughput as a percentage of v5e's peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0) -- same convention as 01_mxu_feed/config.json. This is a rough proxy here: this cell is memory/overhead-bound, not compute-bound, so the more direct signal is grid-step count and wall-clock time (both reported by naive_kernel.py/optimized_kernel.py's __main__ block), not TFLOPS.

metrics.name: num_grid_steps
metrics.description: total pallas_call grid steps for the same logical array size. Naive: 256 (4x64 blocks over 256x256). Optimized: 16 (32x128 blocks). Purely a function of block shape choice, verifiable without any profiler.
